brief: Holds a named tree of nodes and leaf items, and finds, reads and adds nodes and items by name or by path.
detail: It extends stzList. A tree is one named root holding nodes, a node being a name paired with a list that may hold items and further nodes: :root = [ :node1 = [ "X", :node11 = [ "A" ] ], :node2 = [ 1, 2 ] ]. A path names the nodes from the root, as in [:root][:node1], and an item path adds the item's position in its node, as in [:root][:node2][1]. Branches and Nodes list them in depth-first order, Find methods return paths, and NodeAt and ItemAt read what a path points to. Node names are matched without regard to case. Adding goes through AddNodeAt and AddItemAt at the end of a node; a path that does not exist changes nothing without any error. Removing items is not written: RemoveItem and its kin raise Not yet implemented! and RemoveThisItemCS does nothing. FindTheseItems repeats the last path of an item that occurs several times, and FindThisItem answers an empty text.
